decisions.quantity: Plain number plus unit label; no conversions
decisions.import: JSON import adds records and never replaces existing data

issues.title: Set up Firebase project and app integration
acceptance: Firebase services are enabled and documented.
The app initializes Firebase locally.
Local and production configuration are distinct.

issues.title: Add Google authentication
acceptance: Users can sign in and sign out with Google.
Signed-out users cannot access inventory content.
Refreshing preserves the session.

issues.title: Build seed inventory CRUD
acceptance: Records persist under the signed-in user's Firestore path.
Forms validate required fields and non-negative quantities.
Archived records are excluded from the default list.

issues.title: Add quantity adjustment controls
acceptance: Quantity cannot become negative.
Zero quantity is visibly treated as empty.
Updates persist to Firestore.

issues.title: Add inventory search, filters, and sorting
acceptance: Search and filters can be combined.
Users can filter availability, crop, location, and archived state.
Users can sort by name, quantity, and viability date.

issues.title: Build inventory dashboard
acceptance: Archived records are excluded from normal counts.
Empty, soon-to-expire, and expired states are represented.
Empty inventory has a useful state.

issues.title: Add additive JSON import and export
acceptance: Export produces valid JSON.
Import validates the complete file before writing.
The user previews the record count and confirms the import.

issues.title: Add Firestore security rules and error states
acceptance: Cross-user reads and writes are rejected.
Errors are actionable and do not expose internal details.
Security verification evidence is recorded.

issues.title: Deploy MVP with Firebase Hosting
acceptance: The production URL loads and route refreshes work.
Google sign-in and Firestore writes work in production.
Deployment steps are documented.
